facts.fact: KRAY 早上八点敲 Wacker 的门。
facts.anchor: KRAY knocked on Wacker’s door at 8:00 a.m.
When Wacker opened it, his cheeks appeared flushed.

facts.fact: KRAY 在文件末页写下 “TOO MUCH MONEY”。
facts.anchor: At the bottom of the last page, over a triple underscore, KRAY had written “TOO MUCH MONEY.”

facts.fact: 计划派出一千名 NOC 当变革人力资源顾问，预算是两百亿美元。
facts.anchor: we need to get out a thousand NOCs as Transformational Human Resources consultants and have twenty billion dollars to do it with

facts.fact: Wacker 澄清两百亿是年度预算。
facts.anchor: Twenty billion is the annual budget.

facts.fact: 运营资金每年只有几亿美元，是零头。
facts.anchor: That’s small potatoes anyway, just a few hundred million a year.

facts.fact: Wacker 让 KRAY 有 HR 问题就去找 EVERSHAG。
facts.anchor: If you get stuck on any HR issues, go and see EVERSHAG.

facts.fact: KRAY 离开时听到 Wacker 在身后关门上锁。
facts.anchor: He heard Wacker shut and lock the door behind him.
